name: EA Trix
summary: EA Trix is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that uses the Triple Exponential Moving Average (Trix) indicator to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when the Trix indicator crosses above its signal line and enters short positions when it crosses below. The EA is designed to capture momentum shifts while filtering out market noise through the triple smoothing of the TRIX oscillator.
summary_zh: EA Trix是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，使用三重指数移动平均线（Trix）指标来生成交易信号。当Trix指标向上穿越其信号线时做多，向下穿越时做空。该EA通过TRIX振荡器的三重平滑来过滤市场噪音，捕捉动量转换。
strategy_analysis: EA Trix的策略核心是利用三重指数移动平均线（TRIX）指标来识别市场动量的方向变化。入场条件：当TRIX指标线从下方穿越其信号线时开多单，表示动量转为上升；当TRIX线从上方穿越信号线时开空单，表示动量转为下降。出场条件主要依赖反向交叉信号平仓，也可能设置止损和止盈来控制单笔交易的风险。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义交易手数，但缺少基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，EA提供止损止盈参数供用户设置，但未集成复合头寸管理或追踪止损功能。整体而言，该策略属于典型的动量跟踪系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of EA Trix revolves around the Triple Exponential Moving Average (TRIX) oscillator to identify shifts in market momentum direction. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the TRIX line crosses above its signal line, indicating upward momentum; a short position is opened when the TRIX line crosses below its signal line, indicating downward momentum. Exit conditions primarily rely on the opposite crossover signal for closing positions, with optional stop loss and take profit levels to manage individual trade risk. Position sizing allows the user to define a fixed lot size, but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account equity or market volatility. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters, but does not incorporate compound position management, trailing stops, or equity-based risk scaling. Overall, this is a classic momentum-following system best suited for trending markets, though it may generate frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy or range-bound conditions.

pros: 使用TRIX三重平滑有效过滤市场噪音，减少虚假信号
策略逻辑清晰简洁，易于理解和调优
基于动量的趋势跟踪在强趋势市场中表现优异
pros_en: TRIX triple smoothing effectively filters market noise and reduces false signals
Strategy logic is clear and concise, easy to understand and optimize
Momentum-based trend following performs well in strong trending markets
cons: 缺乏动态仓位管理，固定手数无法适应不同市场波动
在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假交叉信号导致连续亏损
缺少追踪止损机制，盈利头寸可能在回撤中丧失大部分利润
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lot size cannot adapt to varying market volatility
Prone to frequent false crossover signals in choppy/range-bound markets, leading to consecutive losses
Missing trailing stop mechanism; profitable positions may give back most gains during pullbacks
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态仓位管理和追踪止损功能
添加趋势过滤器（如更高周期均线）以避免在震荡行情中交易
加入新K线检查和点差过滤，防止在同一根K线上重复开仓和高点差环境下入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic position sizing and trailing stop functionality
Incorporate a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe moving average) to avoid trading in choppy conditions
Add new bar check and spread filter to prevent repeated entries on the same bar and entries during high spread

risk_points: 止损默认为0，如果用户忘记设置则没有任何止损保护
缺少新K线检查可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
固定手数不根据账户资金调整，可能导致过度杠杆
risk_points_en: Stop loss defaults to 0; if user forgets to set it, there is no downside protection
Missing new bar check may cause repeated position openings on the same candle
Fixed lot size does not adjust to account equity, potentially leading to over-leveraging
